purpose: Run the USF validator suite to check mutual consistency of semantics, references and controlled values.
failureSemantics: Fails closed on contradiction, ambiguity, unknown controlled values, or unresolved references.
title: Command using a canonical commandKind value
description: Valid command artefact whose commandKind is a canonical command-kinds value, with non-empty inputs and outputs and empty environmentScope and sideEffects.
aiGuidance: Treat this as a governed validation command; do not weaken its failure semantics to make a run appear to pass.
